summary.name: Iconology
summary.one_liner: A free, open source Mac app for importing, editing, and exporting app icons in many formats and sizes.
use_cases: Generating iOS, macOS, and Apple Watch app icon sets for Xcode
Creating .icns or .ico icon files from a single image
Producing favicons and PNGs at custom sizes
Adding rounding, drop shadows, or gradient backgrounds to icons
Resizing and padding artwork to fit icon presets
summary.what_it_does: Iconology imports images in formats such as PNG, JPG, AI, PSD, and PDF, then lets you adjust them with background color, scale, horizontal and vertical shift, aspect-ratio-preserving editing, rounding (circular, continuous, or squircle), drop shadows, gradient backgrounds, and padding. It exports to Xcode-ready JSON for iOS, macOS, Message, and Apple Watch icon sets, plus .icns, .ico, Mac iconset, favicons, and PNGs of any size. Users can create custom presets, and selecting a preset applies default adjustments and one-click macOS generation. The page lists version 2.0 as a rewrite using SwiftUI with multiple editor windows and color space control.
notable: Open source, with source available on GitHub
Exports Xcode-ready JSON so the icon folder can be dragged into Xcode
Native macOS interface built with SwiftUI
Custom presets and continuous (macOS-style) and squircle rounding modes
caveats: Requires macOS 13.0 (Ventura) or later; older versions are available from GitHub
Page states the app has not received enough ratings or reviews to show an overview
Mac only; no iOS or Windows version is named on the page
